messages:
Nina (infra): Quick follow-up from the GPU postmortem. Creating a compact action thread to lock owners and ACs. Short replies only please.
Otto (sre): Got it. Please include clear acceptance criteria for closures.
Nina (infra): Agreed. Actions below with owners + hard ACs.

ACTIONS: 
1) Hard quota backstop: owner=Otto; due=2026-04-05; AC=allocs rejected at >=95% reserved_pool and PagerDuty fired if rejection rate >3/min. Exclude spot pools.
2) Scheduler conservative packing + cooldown: owner=Priya; due=2026-03-31; AC=staging shows no global preempt storm and <2% perf regression. Config diff posted on PR.
3) Headroom forecast + dashboard: owner=Carlos; due=2026-04-09; AC=dashboard panel + forecast MAPE <18% for 24h; runbook step to execute ramp.
4) Surge detector gating + OpsBot hook: owner=Nina+OpsBot; due=2026-04-16; AC=detector tags incidents with "surge-detector", triggers warm pool (no auto spin beyond 10%).
5) Borrow workflow drill: owner=Nina; due=2026-04-08; AC=one successful simulated borrow with audit entry.

Priya (sched): I'll take 2. I'll lower packing_factor to 0.72 in staging and add 90s eviction cooldown. PR ready for review.
Otto (sre): Taking 1 and supporting 5 for ops flow. I'll add unit tests and a short runbook. PR will be up today.
Carlos (capacity): Taking 3. Prototype with EWMA baseline + daily seasonality. Dashboard ETA 2026-04-06.
Nina (infra): OpsBot, can you expose a slash command to approve borrow and log approver IDs?
OpsBot: automated-message: added /ops borrow-approve (requires 2 approvers). Tags incidents with "surge-detector" when created by detector. Audit log enabled.
Otto (sre): Quick Q: Who validates dedicated vs shared policies?
Carlos (capacity): I'll reconcile pool mappings and confirm policy lists by 2026-03-29.
Priya (sched): Staging run scheduled 2026-03-28; if green, canary 2026-03-30.
Nina (infra): Weekly check-ins Fridays 09:30 PT. I'll post short status notes here. Close items with PR links + AC evidence.
Otto (sre): Draft PR: https://git.redwood/example/pr/6010 (quota backstop).
Priya (sched): Scheduler PR: https://git.redwood/example/pr/6011
Carlos (capacity): Dashboard draft: https://grafana.redwood/d/abcd/headroom (will add more panels).
Nina (infra): Thanks all. Keep changes minimal during canaries. Next check-in Friday. OpsBot: remind in 7 days.
OpsBot: automated-message: followup-tracker created; owners assigned: Otto, Priya, Carlos, Nina. Next automated reminder in 7 days.
